scope: Current OpenAPI v2 operation-to-Axum-handler source inventory; excludes consumer audit.

qualification.boundary: Static OpenAPI/router/handler-source mapping only. No build, tests, HTTP runtime, browser, physics, or release qualification was run.

provenance.head: 42d92610312871d591db16a5b60a8f7a6d6339b5
provenance.source_basis: Current checkout source; relevant OpenAPI and router inputs were verified unchanged relative to HEAD before generation.

consumer_evidence.reason: Shared checkout contains unrelated dirty source files; consumer evidence is not required for handler mapping and was deliberately excluded.

baseline_comparison.delta_basis: HTTP method plus normalized OpenAPI path

mapping_method.route_matching: Normalized HTTP method and path from generated OpenAPI matched to literal Axum registrations in router_v2/mod.rs.
mapping_method.handler_resolution: Handler symbol matched to its Rust function definition under router_v2 using audit_refactor_p0.py.
mapping_method.meaning_of_found: Source symbol resolution only; it does not establish semantic correctness, compilation, execution, authorization correctness, or consumer migration.

limitations: Consumer/call-site evidence was intentionally excluded because unrelated files in the shared checkout are dirty.
Handler resolution is lexical source evidence, not a review of handler behavior or its downstream use cases.
Router-only entries are registered Axum routes absent from generated OpenAPI; they are listed separately and are not counted among the 371 OpenAPI operations.
All review statuses are REVIEW REQUIRED; no historical SOURCE PASS status is carried forward.
